How much the xAGNA script layer writes to its logs. 
 Error: failures only. 
 Warning (default): failures and skipped edits. 
 Info: also the game-start summary of applied edits. 
 Debug: the full per-event trace of every PDA, wounded, and animation-table change to xagna.log, PLUS a sampled log of the animation states NPCs actually play, written to xagna_animations.log.
